description: Every seed range the program has used or reserved. New families must overlap none of these. Historical ranges come from the Complete Project Dossier (Appendix B) and the E2 prereg; the v0.34.1 range is confirmed by the split recorded in state/event_consistent_self_development_test_v1/result.json in the Windows source mirror (UNVERIFIED against the canonical tree).
